pt_Eccentric_Step_Down: Stand on a low step on one leg
Slowly lower the other foot to the floor
pt_Seated_Leg_Extension_Isometric: Light weight, lift to a comfortable angle
pt_Side_Lying_External_Rotation: Lie on your side, towel under the elbow
Rotate the dumbbell up, elbow stays put
pt_Prone_Y_T_W_Raise: Lie face down on an incline bench
Raise your arms in a Y, then a T, then a W
pt_Wall_Push_Up: Hands on the wall, shoulder width
Bring your chest to the wall, body straight
pt_Pendulum_Swing: Lean forward, one hand on a table
Let the other arm hang loose
Make small circles using your body
pt_Half_Kneeling_Landmine_Press: One knee down, bar at your shoulder
Press up and forward on the angle
pt_Band_Scapular_Retraction: Hold the band in front, arms straight
Squeeze only your shoulder blades back
pt_Serratus_Wall_Slide: Roller on the wall under your forearms
Slide up while pushing gently forward
pt_Glute_Bridge_Hold: Lift your hips and squeeze your glutes
pt_Supine_Pelvic_Tilt: Flatten your lower back by bracing your abs
pt_Quadruped_Rock_Back: On hands and knees, back flat
Rock your hips back toward your heels
pt_Side_Lying_Hip_Abduction: Lie on your side, bottom knee bent
Lift the top leg straight and slightly back
pt_Single_Leg_Glute_Bridge_Bench: Upper back on the bench, one foot down
Drive through the heel and lock out with your glutes
pt_Dumbbell_Seal_Row: Lie face down on a high bench
Row the dumbbells with your elbows
pt_Dumbbell_Pullover_Bench: Lower the dumbbell behind your head, soft elbows
Bring it back over your chest
pt_Incline_Dumbbell_Y_Raise: Lie face down on an incline bench
Raise the dumbbells into a Y
pt_Machine_Preacher_Hammer_Curl: Arms on the preacher pad, rope in hand
Curl up with palms facing each other
pt_Cable_Single_Arm_Lateral_Raise_Behind: Raise your arm out to shoulder height
pt_Smith_Machine_Close_Grip_Incline: Lower the bar to your upper chest
pt_Machine_Chest_Fly_Single_Arm: Bring one handle to the middle
pt_Seated_Dumbbell_Calf_Raise: Sit with dumbbells on your knees, balls of the feet on a plate
pt_Reverse_Nordic: Kneel with a straight line from knees to head
pt_Frog_Stance_Pump: Soles together, dumbbell on your hips
